data.body: CI/Gerrit update: change 2602 patchset 5 remains blocked before submit by failures unrelated to this leaf. LLM-Review is +1, local lint/typecheck/targeted tests passed, and the known ubuntu py3.11 editor E2E worker crash reproduced as the same environmental failure seen on earlier patchsets. A new scanner-integration lane from current origin/main is also failing deterministically before tests with `/bin/sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail` in Makefile target `scanner-integration` (current main line uses `set -euo pipefail` under make's default /bin/sh). Fixing that requires editing Makefile, which is outside this ticket's declared file_impact, so I am stopping rather than force or expand scope myself.
